data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root m-h-j, meaning 'to strive, to make an effort'. It symbolizes the struggle and determination in achieving one's goals in life. In Islamic context, it is associated with the journey towards self-improvement and spiritual growth. The name Muhja carries the meaning “Effort, Struggle, Striving” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhja usually hope their child will grow to embody effort, struggle, striving and live with faith, good character and purpose.
